title: Mexican-Style Ukrainian Dumplings
description: A fusion twist on traditional Ukrainian dumplings, filled with spicy Mexican flavors. Serve as a main dish or snack.

ingredients.name: All-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: make sure to use a gluten-free flour for a gluten-free option

ingredients.name: Ground beef
ingredients.notes: cooked and seasoned with Mexican spices

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and warm water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of seasoned ground beef in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the dumplings for 10-12 minutes.
While the dumplings are cooking, heat a skillet with a tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Serve the cooked dumplings with the onion and garlic mixture, topped with shredded Mexican cheese and a dollop of sour cream.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
